name: clips/t5_city_oner
prompt: One continuous first-person POV shot, no cuts, no people anywhere, no hood, no hands. The camera walks slowly and steadily straight forward along the middle of the flooded city quay in heavy rain, always facing straight ahead toward the stone bridge, gentle natural walking bob. Lit apartment windows and café awnings pass on the left, the black river and the city skyline with spires on the right. The floodwater on the quay gets deeper with each step. At about four seconds a bright flash of lightning lights the whole city for a moment, then darkness returns. The camera stops walking and tilts slowly straight down to your own white sneakers standing ankle-deep, fully submerged in dark rippling floodwater, rain hitting the surface, and holds. Realistic, cinematic 35mm film look, no text.
